<a id="a-family-of-readings-within-what-it-reads--在所读之中的读法族"></a>
# A family of readings within what it reads

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`readings-within-what-they-read` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](readings-within-what-they-read.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Over inhabited types with values' equality decided, some family of readings indexed by what it reads is complete exactly where nothing differs; where a map moves every value, completing it is an unfolding incomplete at every step, not returning, held by no finite stock; the liar has no still value.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. For any family ψ : A → A → B of readings indexed by what it reads and any likeness of values, a member says a reading g where its value is alike with g's at every argument, and the gap of a map f is x ↦ f (ψ x x). Where f moves every value, none alike with its image, no member says the gap. (`Becoming.Diagonal.Says`, `Becoming.Diagonal.gap`, `Becoming.Diagonal.Moves`, `Becoming.Diagonal.gap_unsaid`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
2. A family saying every reading gives every map f some value b alike with f b; with likeness transitive, a member saying g says every reading alike with g at each argument. (`Becoming.Diagonal.fixed_of_complete`, `Becoming.Diagonal.Says.congr`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
3. No claim is equivalent to its negation, so no family of claims indexed by what it reads says every reading, none saying x ↦ ¬ ψ x x, and no frame whose claims are its own configurations realizes with them every pattern of claims about them. (`Becoming.Diagonal.moves_not`, `Becoming.Diagonal.claims_incomplete`, `Becoming.Diagonal.claims_gap`, `Becoming.Frame.self_incomplete`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
4. For values compared by equality: a family saying every reading makes every value equal to b where equality with b is decided; where all values are equal and A and B have elements, some family says every reading; with equality of values decided and A and B inhabited, some family says every reading exactly where all values are equal. (`Becoming.Diagonal.alike_of_complete`, `Becoming.Diagonal.complete_of_alike`, `Becoming.Diagonal.complete_iff_alike`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
5. A sequence of families unfolds under f where each step keeps every reading said before and the next step says the step's gap. Where f moves every value, every step of an unfolding misses its own gap, and no step m says the gap of any step m + k. (`Becoming.Diagonal.Unfolds`, `Becoming.Diagonal.Unfolds.keeps_on`, `Becoming.Diagonal.Unfolds.incomplete`, `Becoming.Diagonal.Unfolds.gap_new`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
6. Where f moves every value, in an unfolding under f: with likeness transitive, the gap of step m is not alike at every argument with that of any step m + 1 + k; and not everything step n + 1 + k says is said at step n, so it never returns. (`Becoming.Diagonal.Unfolds.gaps_differ`, `Becoming.Diagonal.Unfolds.never_returns`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
7. With likeness symmetric and transitive, for every L, pairwise different readings are not all alike with members of a stock of L readings, with no decision on the values; so where f moves every value, no finite stock holds every gap of an unfolding under f. (`Becoming.Diagonal.two_ne_odd`, `Becoming.Diagonal.stock_unheld`, `Becoming.Diagonal.Unfolds.unheld`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
8. On Bool with negation, which moves every value, the sequence unfolding unfolds: every step misses its own gap, not everything a later step says is said at an earlier one, and no stock of L readings holds every gap, for every L. (`Becoming.Diagonal.unfolding`, `Becoming.Diagonal.unfolding_fresh`, `Becoming.Diagonal.unfolding_zero`, `Becoming.Diagonal.flip_moves`, `Becoming.Diagonal.unfolding_unfolds`, `Becoming.Diagonal.unfolding_open`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
9. Revising a value by a map that moves every value under equality changes it at every step of its orbit; revising a claim by negation changes it at every step up to equivalence; the two-valued negation returns to its start along its orbit. (`Becoming.Diagonal.revision_never_rests`, `Becoming.Diagonal.negation_never_rests`, `Becoming.Diagonal.negation_returns`, `Becoming.Law.orbit`, `Becoming.Law.Returns`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* finite runs; its declarations do not reach the grammar.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No premise: gap_unsaid, claims_incomplete, the laws of Unfolds and the rhythm hold for every family, type of values and likeness.
- Local conditions are written into the theorems: alike_of_complete needs equality with one value decided, complete_iff_alike needs equality of values decidable, gaps_differ needs same transitive, stock_unheld needs it symmetric and transitive (deciding only on natural-number indices).
- The readings form a family indexed by what they read, a supplied reading; arithmetic coding and provability are not stated.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Gödel's incompleteness and the halting problem lie outside its laws: arithmetic coding and provability are not stated.
- Completeness exactly where nothing differs is for values compared by decided equality; for claims the laws give incompleteness only.
- The rhythm is shown periodic for the two-valued negation only; for any other map moving every value, only that revision never rests.
- **Counterexample:** The unfolding on Bool (unfolding_open): incomplete at every step, never returning, its gaps held by no finite stock; revising the two-valued negation never rests (revision_never_rests, flip_moves). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Diagonal.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision.

<details><summary>Correspondence, dependencies, sources and history</summary>

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Following Ren's “push the frontier, as far as possible” of 12 October 2026. The periphery's RootCoverageBoundary (mathematical abstraction, CoverageBoundary.lean, importing Std) has the function and predicate forms of the same diagonal (fixed_point_of_complete, diagonal_extension_strict); here it is restated in the core with no axiom, with completeness exactly where nothing differs, the completing unfolding and the rhythm added. It tests the “from within” half of Ren's speculation: any given truth can be said at the next step, not all from one situation, and the limit is the projection's. The negation's two states are read off revision_never_rests (Negation.two_states). Readings (AI readings): Zhuangzi's 一与言为二，二与一为三 has the regress form of Unfolds; a self-prediction announced into its loop has no still right value; the earlier reading of 道可道 as “说不尽” was the AI's, not Ren's.

  - Output: Orbits and return.
  - Input: The rhythm; gaps pairwise different.
  - Preserved conditions: None. [Recurrence.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Recurrence.lean)
- related, not a proved adapter: [the-split-that-makes-sense](the-split-that-makes-sense.md). The negation's exactly two states are read off the same rhythm.
- related, not a proved adapter: [claims-shown-in-context](claims-shown-in-context.md). Another limit of projection: context-free values; here, holding every reading from within.
- related, not a proved adapter: [learning-by-refutation](learning-by-refutation.md). Its diagonal_misses and diagonal_unrested are the extrapolation's form, of the same form as gap_unsaid and revision_never_rests and a different object, written independently.
